name: io.github.anyproto/anytype-mcp
description: Official MCP server for Anytype API - your encrypted, local and collaborative wiki.

environment_variables.description: JSON string of headers for Anytype API. Example: {"Authorization":"Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>", "Anytype-Version":"2025-11-08"}
environment_variables.name: OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS

environment_variables.description: Tool set of Anytype's built-in MCP server: full (default, one tool per API operation), large or small
environment_variables.name: ANYTYPE_MCP_TIER

environment_variables.description: Anytype API address. Default: http://127.0.0.1:31009 (anytype-cli: http://127.0.0.1:31012)
environment_variables.name: ANYTYPE_API_BASE_URL

environment_variables.description: The only directory upload_local_file reads from and download_file writes to (absolute path). Default: ~/.anytype-mcp/files
environment_variables.name: ANYTYPE_MCP_FILES_DIR
